recording_scope: All control/status and odometry, full-rate published HT maps and TARE collision geometry; original-stamped scans1Hz; exact-stamp map triplets and network inputs/outputs every10s; camera15fps. Raw CuPy and scans are not fully bagged.

mission.meaning: Exploration finished is a return-home trigger. Only mission COMPLETED confirms the home radius, low-speed and dwell checks; neither establishes ground-truth full coverage.

geometry.limitations: Uses bag arrival order, latest received odometry/command and measured collision-cloud points in robot height slice. Does not reproduce planner collision-grid bounds or exact callback state. Predicted arc uses last received constant Twist, not controller internal candidate or simulator braking. Margin overlap is not physical vehicle contact. Sample lag/point noise may contribute; cannot separate them without independent truth.

limitations: Single indoor trial; ground-truth full coverage not independently validated. Added geometry rejection branches did not trigger in this run; actual-zero branches are ROS regression tested. Changed tracking margin and trajectory prevent independent attribution to execution guard alone.
